verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the rendezvous or relay servers is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents the CLI, the REST API, custom client modules and the my.anydesk cloud console. Nothing shows an on-premises or self-hosted rendezvous/relay deployment. Custom clients and API automation are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run
